540: export function makeWave(wave, mapId = 'tatooine') {
541:   const map = getMap(mapId);
542:   const growth = Math.pow(map.hpGrowth, wave - 1);
543:   const mix = map.mix;
544:   const specs = [];
545:   let delay = 0.6;
546:   const push = (type, count, hpMul = 1, gapOverride = 0) => {
547:     const def = ENEMY_TYPES[type];
548:     const gap = gapOverride || def.gap;
549:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
550:       delay += gap;
551:       specs.push({
552:         type,
553:         hp: Math.round(map.hpBase * growth * def.hp * hpMul),
554:         speed: def.speed,
555:         delay,
556:       });
557:     }
558:     delay += 0.35;
559:   };
560: 
561:   const bossEvery = map.bossEvery == null ? 10 : map.bossEvery;
562:   const bossWave = (bossEvery > 0 && wave % bossEvery === 0) || wave === map.waves;
563:   const isFinal = wave === map.waves;
564: 
565:   let lineCount = Math.round((6 + wave * 0.9) * mix.lineRate);
566:   let fastCount = wave >= mix.fastStart ? Math.max(1, Math.round((wave - 1) * mix.fastRate)) : 0;
567:   let heavyCount = wave >= mix.heavyStart ? Math.max(1, Math.floor((wave - mix.heavyStart + 1) * mix.heavyRate)) : 0;
568:   if (bossWave) {
569:     lineCount = Math.round(lineCount * 0.55);
570:     fastCount = Math.round(fastCount * 0.5);
571:     heavyCount = Math.max(1, Math.round(heavyCount * 0.5));
572:   }
573: 
574:   const roster = map.roster;
575: 
576:   // Opening skirmishers.
577:   const openingFast = fastCount ? Math.min(fastCount, Math.ceil(fastCount * 0.45)) : 0;
578:   if (openingFast) push(roster.fast, openingFast, 1, Math.max(0.28, ENEMY_TYPES[roster.fast].gap * 0.82));
579: 
580:   // Main line squads with short pauses between them.
581:   const squads = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(lineCount / 9));
582:   const perSquad = Math.ceil(lineCount / squads);
583:   for (let s = 0; s < squads; s++) {
584:     const count = Math.min(perSquad, lineCount - s * perSquad);
585:     if (count > 0) push(roster.line, count, 1);
586:     if (s < squads - 1) delay += 0.55;
587:   }
588: 
589:   // Heavy armour.
590:   if (heavyCount) {
591:     delay += 0.2;
592:     push(roster.heavy, heavyCount, 1, Math.max(0.8, ENEMY_TYPES[roster.heavy].gap * 0.86));
593:   }
594: 
595:   // Remaining fast units harass the back line.
596:   const restFast = fastCount - openingFast;
597:   if (restFast > 0) push(roster.fast, restFast, 1, Math.max(0.28, ENEMY_TYPES[roster.fast].gap * 0.8));
598: 
599:   if (bossWave) {
600:     const bossMul = isFinal ? (map.finalBossMul ?? 1.45) : 1;
601:     push(roster.boss, isFinal ? (map.finalBossCount ?? 2) : 1, bossMul, 1.6);
602:     if (isFinal) push(roster.heavy, 3, 1.3, 1.0);
603:   }
604: 
605:   return specs;
606: }
